title: Reconcile a bounded out-of-scope decision
expected_summary: Preserves a valid out-of-scope boundary, records the deferral without accepting the proposed design, and cleans up once the review is settled.

turns.user: Continue the automatic review after my file edits.

Records the deferred scope boundary in the specification and relevant context without writing the proposed recovery design as accepted.

Emits a Cleanup summary after cleanup, including No cleanup changes were required. when appropriate.
